root.note: The ROOT session model is chosen by the client (Claude Desktop model picker / CLI flag). OSER never pins it unless the project declares an explicit, verified-enforceable id.

frontier-audit.note: Family preference only. Resolved at activation to the newest generation OBSERVED on this machine; never activated outside an explicit audit gate.

investigate.summary: Measure the real environment, read code and authority, report evidence. Runs in the ROOT session.

strategy.summary: Owns WHAT/WHY decisions. Human + strategy session, outside the implementation repo.

implement.summary: Write production code for an accepted work item.

review.summary: Adversarial read-only review of a change against declared rules.

test.summary: Write and run tests against declared acceptance.

map-code.summary: Mechanical lookup: paths, callers, suite runs.

audit.summary: Frontier-model audit at an explicit gate. Never a ROOT profile, never always-on.
